classification.reason: The KB explicitly states that two identical charges on the same day is a billing error that must be escalated to a human rather than resolved by the agent.

draft.reply: {"reply": "Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the trouble. Two charges for the exact same amount ($45.00) on the same day for your Team plan is not expected behavior — this pattern is treated as a billing error rather than a normal proration or renewal event, so I'm escalating your case to our billing team for a human to investigate and resolve directly. You don't need to take any action on your end for now. In the meantime, you can view both charges under Settings > Billing > Invoices to confirm the details, which will help speed up the review. We'll follow up with you as soon as we have an update.", "citations": ["billing_faq.md#q-i-was-charged-twice-this-month-what-happened"]}
